acts.title: The Last Warm District
acts.dramaticQuestion: Who pays when the city saves itself?
acts.actReveal: A maintenance line and food shipments point to an unlisted relay facility.

acts.title: A City Divided
acts.dramaticQuestion: Who gets to know the truth, and who controls emergency power?
acts.actReveal: Jorel’s death was never verified; records point toward a living settlement on the northern ridge.

acts.title: The Signal Beneath the Ice
acts.dramaticQuestion: What does the darkness protect, and what does it conceal?
acts.actReveal: Hearth-9 survives beyond the ridge; records place Jorel at the outer relay, and DAWNLINE’s active safety cycle is independently corroborated.

acts.title: The Architecture of Night
acts.dramaticQuestion: Can the truth be made public without destroying the fragile system that keeps people alive?
acts.actReveal: Mara’s override saved a local heat loop during the emergency. DAWNLINE requires a witnessed human interlock and a coordinated test before any reset can be considered.

acts.title: Afterlight
acts.dramaticQuestion: Will the future belong to the people who survive it?
acts.actReveal: Vesper’s final coalition, Jorel’s rescue decision, and the accumulated evidence determine whether humanity restores natural sunlight, preserves artificial dawn, rebuilds under civilian or security rule, evacuates north, or suffers a catastrophic shutdown.

nodes.liveCityFeed: Energy channels visibly illuminate one subsystem.

nodes.title: The record goes live
nodes.trigger: public-trial/full archive/public knowledge state
nodes.decisionSpace: Broadcast verified evidence now or let the operation speak first.
nodes.connections: Public disclosure changes cooperation and unrest; withheld evidence enables authoritarian control but damages post-reset legitimacy.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Civic displays/people in plaza update.

nodes.title: The last calibration
nodes.trigger: Mara trusted or engineering record preserved
nodes.decisionSpace: Give Mara direct authority, use a second engineer, or deny her access.
nodes.connections: Trusted Mara lowers technical risk; excluding her costs time; coercion may prompt refusal.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Gantry close-up state reflects crew availability.

nodes.title: The people at the switchyard
nodes.trigger: Ilya relationship and public legitimacy states
nodes.decisionSpace: Invite civilian observers, negotiate with the crowd, or clear the switchyard.
nodes.connections: Strong Ilya trust creates a safe civilian corridor; repression may trigger strike/siege.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Crowd clears, coordinates, or surges.

nodes.title: The order that will be remembered
nodes.trigger: security-oath and Vale standing
nodes.decisionSpace: Order Vale to hold the line, transfer command, or accept his emergency plan.
nodes.connections: Defines whether security protects the operation, withdraws, or attempts a takeover.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Searchlight/security layer updates.

nodes.title: Hold the signal open
nodes.trigger: Elias trust plus repaired relay
nodes.decisionSpace: Let Elias keep the channel open or cut interference manually.
nodes.connections: Good standing preserves timing; poor standing creates a manual-risk option.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Aurora pulse aligns or breaks.

nodes.title: Who will remember this honestly?
nodes.trigger: Nadia trust and archive disposition
nodes.decisionSpace: Release the entire verified record or preserve sealed evidence for a later tribunal.
nodes.connections: Determines public history, character survival/loyalty epilogues, and legitimacy ending gate.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Public archive feed changes.

nodes.title: The ridge gives its answer
nodes.trigger: ridge alliance + timing evidence
nodes.decisionSpace: Synchronise two-city pulse or attempt Vesper-only alignment.
nodes.connections: Coordinated pulse lowers risk; solo pulse possible only if technical safeguards compensate.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Twin artificial-sun beams align across scene.

nodes.title: Into the machine’s memory
nodes.trigger: DAWNLINE access + telemetry + proper command authorization
nodes.decisionSpace: Enter with human key and evidence or bypass the lockout.
nodes.connections: Human key creates accountable reset; bypass risks permanent lockout/last-light route.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Core chamber and network UI change.

nodes.title: Keep the shield, open the gap
nodes.trigger: DAWNLINE core entered
nodes.decisionSpace: Preserve emergency shield in staged mode or open a narrow controlled corridor.
nodes.connections: A full shutdown is never offered as a safe default; the meaningful choice is the transition protocol.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Sky begins warming only in staged/corridor sequence.

nodes.title: Two cities, one timing window
nodes.trigger: ridge-pulse-window plus core safety protocol
nodes.decisionSpace: Accept northern authority on timing or centralise command in Vesper.
nodes.connections: Joint governance creates the safest reset; unilateral command is faster but raises failure risk.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Twin relay signals synchronise.

nodes.title: Who owns the morning?
nodes.trigger: network handshake and security outcome
nodes.decisionSpace: Choose civic compact, technical trusteeship, emergency command, or evacuation leadership.
nodes.connections: Selects political structure of epilogues, not whether the engineering outcome automatically succeeds.
nodes.liveCityFeed: City civic/security state becomes permanent.

nodes.title: The last pulse
nodes.trigger: Power allocation, relay lock, calibration, grid and command states
nodes.decisionSpace: Execute staged pulse, abort into permanent artificial light, or evacuate before a failed core.
nodes.connections: Engine calculates success/risk from prior state. No outcome is random without warning; risks are telegraphed.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Dawn only if success conditions resolve.

nodes.title: The cost of the future
nodes.trigger: Any ending condition
nodes.decisionSpace: No new life-or-death choice; present the campaign ledger.
nodes.connections: Summarises districts saved/lost, key relationships, evidence published, and the decisions that made the ending possible.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Final Live City Feed freeze-frame.

nodes.title: ENDING — The First Morning
nodes.trigger: Staged pulse succeeds; sufficient technology, power, evidence, coordination, and live grid
nodes.decisionSpace: Natural light returns through a stable corridor; DAWNLINE moves to supervised recovery.
nodes.connections: Best scientific outcome; epilogue changes with public legitimacy and character testimony.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Golden natural dawn; skyline stays transformed.

nodes.title: ENDING — The Eternal City
nodes.trigger: Reset deliberately deferred/aborted; stable engine + viable food + no catastrophic collapse
nodes.decisionSpace: Vesper survives using improved artificial light and a repaired civic/infrastructure system.
nodes.connections: A defensible, bittersweet survival ending; not a “bad” ending if chosen knowingly.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Stable warm artificial sun, no natural sunrise.

nodes.title: ENDING — The People’s Dawn
nodes.trigger: Recovery/reset succeeds with high civic legitimacy, accountable command, and public evidence
nodes.decisionSpace: The transition belongs to a civic compact rather than one leader or machine.
nodes.connections: Best political outcome; scientific outcome may be partial but public ownership is durable.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Sunrise plus busy, lit public square.

nodes.title: ENDING — The Iron Winter
nodes.trigger: Vesper survives, but Vale/emergency command dominates and truth stays restricted
nodes.decisionSpace: The city remains alive and orderly under permanent emergency authority.
nodes.connections: Control ending with high survival but low freedom; character epilogues reflect coercion.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Searchlights and controlled districts beneath artificial dawn.

nodes.title: ENDING — Beyond the Ridge
nodes.trigger: Reset not viable, but route, supplies, settlement agreement, and evacuation plan are secured
nodes.decisionSpace: Vesper evacuates a viable population toward the northern settlement.
nodes.connections: Hopeful migration ending; the fate of the old city and those left behind is stated honestly.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Convoy lights cross the frozen ridge.

nodes.title: ENDING — The Last Light
nodes.trigger: Survival threshold breached or the final operation fails without an alternative plan
nodes.decisionSpace: The engine fails and the city cannot sustain a transition.
nodes.connections: Tragic ending summarises which earlier choices narrowed the options; not an arbitrary random death.
nodes.liveCityFeed: City scene loses light according to the systems that failed.

nodes.title: The storm erases the road
nodes.trigger: The ridge route is exposed or reserve levels indicate a serious weather risk.
nodes.decisionSpace: Burn an emergency beacon, press downhill, or shelter and wait.
nodes.connections: Consumes or preserves supplies; changes whether the expedition reaches the station safely.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The city feed shows an unstable beacon trace and the field team crossing a whiteout.

nodes.title: The outer post is still calling
nodes.trigger: The required Act III main route has resolved; optional clues are retained when earned.
nodes.decisionSpace: Prioritise a personal rescue, a shared safety compact, or tracing the autonomous command chain.
nodes.connections: Sets the priority that opens Act IV and preserves evidence, settlement ties, and Jorel conditions.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The view shifts from the ridge contact to the outer relay coordinates.

nodes.title: The relay has a human lock
nodes.trigger: Act III climax is complete.
nodes.decisionSpace: Choose whether rescue, the inter-city protocol, or the command trace leads Act IV.
nodes.connections: Opens Act IV and creates the first operations-board commitment.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The relay map overlays the city scene; a human lock is now the operational obstacle.

nodes.title: Two cities, one dangerous switch
nodes.trigger: The Act IV operations briefing is resolved.
nodes.decisionSpace: Public mandate, temporary technical authority, or a binding two-city compact.
nodes.connections: Sets political legitimacy, working relationships, shared control evidence, and emergency supplies.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The scene moves to Vesper’s joint civic chamber and the Dawnline control sublevel.

nodes.title: The lock recognises a living operator
nodes.trigger: Jorel’s maintenance code is present in the persistent evidence record.
nodes.decisionSpace: Authenticate jointly with a Hearth-9 witness or misuse the code as root authority.
nodes.connections: Establishes a human interlock or raises the DAWNLINE security alert.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The facility changes to the human-lock state; an unauthorised attempt can trigger a breach warning.

nodes.title: The human lock cannot be spoofed
nodes.trigger: Jorel’s maintenance code is absent or Line 9 was sealed.
nodes.decisionSpace: Request Hearth-9’s witness or force a mechanical bypass.
nodes.connections: Can create a witnessed lock procedure or leave the relay in an unstable condition.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The lock remains physically visible; a forced bypass creates a persistent hazard.

nodes.title: The person behind the missing record
nodes.trigger: No confirmed current Jorel signal is available after the manual lock procedure.
nodes.decisionSpace: Authorise a search, ask Hearth-9 to authenticate a maintenance window, or restrict the operation.
nodes.connections: Keeps Jorel’s fate open while advancing the shared safety work.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The live signal caption changes to an unconfirmed location and an open rescue request.

nodes.title: The second test window
nodes.trigger: The first pulse was deferred and the reserve/rebuild scene has resolved.
nodes.decisionSpace: Run a second controlled test or abort the pulse and preserve the local system.
nodes.connections: Re-evaluates the actual safety state, determining success or safe failure before the final vote.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The artificial sun enters a second, timed calibration window.

nodes.title: The last window
nodes.trigger: The Act IV final vote records the chosen strategy.
nodes.decisionSpace: Prepare the coordinated reset, reinforce the local artificial dawn, or open the protected evacuation route.
nodes.connections: This is the implemented Act V opening only; the remaining final campaign and endings are still planned.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The final operations room shows the next autonomous closure window approaching.

nodes.title: Who stands at the final console?
nodes.trigger: Act V briefing has resolved and the final closure window is approaching.
nodes.decisionSpace: Commit to an engineering coalition, civilian witnesses, unified security command, or evacuation convoy.
nodes.connections: The chosen coalition gates the endings; character relationships record who was trusted or excluded.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The city feed shows crews assembling, public witnesses gathering, security cordons, or evacuation transport.

nodes.title: A voice at the outer relay
nodes.trigger: The final coalition is chosen; current signal evidence governs rescue availability.
nodes.decisionSpace: Extract Jorel using an authenticated live channel, request a search, or keep the relay staffed.
nodes.connections: Adds a personal consequence to the finale without claiming a rescue that the evidence cannot support.
nodes.liveCityFeed: The outer-relay signal, rescue roster and convoy status alter the feed caption.

nodes.title: Afterlight
nodes.trigger: Final coalition and Jorel dispatch are recorded.
nodes.decisionSpace: Choose one of six distinct campaign endings, with safe reset gated on the tested pulse, compact, human interlock, engineering coalition and shared-control evidence.
nodes.connections: Resolves the campaign immediately; ending title, result text, and city scene follow the recorded outcome.
nodes.liveCityFeed: Natural dawn, local artificial light, civilian recovery, authoritarian order, northern evacuation, or catastrophic shutdown.
